statement.text: How many independent basic classes can a simply connected smooth 4-manifold X have, as measured $bybr(X)$, the rank of the span of the basic classes? (a) Is there an upper bound $forbr(X)$ in terms of topological invariants of X? (b) In particular, is $br(X) \leq b^{+}_{2}(X)$ for all simply connected X with $b^{+}_{2}(X)$ odd? (c) Is there a smooth indefinite, simply connected 4-manifold X with $b_{2}(X) \geq$ 3 for which the image of $ev_{*}: \operatorname{Diff}(X) \to \operatorname{Aut}(Q_{X})$ is finite, or even trivial?

title: Kirby Problem 4.63
